capabilities: Configure this installation's peer messaging listener and identity.
description: Enable or disable peer messaging. Set listen=true only on the reachable node that accepts incoming WebSocket sessions; listen defaults false so a desktop can connect outward without binding a port. Supply a stable node_id. Listener default host is 127.0.0.1 and port is 24780. Durably admits settings; poll debug_peer_connections to confirm application. Only active admin bots may configure it. Configure the other installation through independently authorized administration access.
name: configure_peer_messaging
